dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Good morning. What time does breakfast start?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd ˈmɔːrnɪŋ. ˈwʌt ˈtaɪm dʌz ˈbrɛkfəst ˈstɑːrt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: It starts at six thirty. It's a buffet in the restaurant.
dialogue.reading: ɪt ˈstɑːrts ət ˈsɪks ˈθɜːrti. ɪts ə bəˈfeɪ ɪn ðə ˈrɛstərɑːnt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Do we have to pay for it?
dialogue.reading: duː wiː ˈhæf tə ˈpeɪ fər ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: No, breakfast is free of charge for all our guests.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ˈbrɛkfəst ɪz ˈfriː əv ˈtʃɑːrdʒ fər ˈɔːl aʊər ˈɡɛsts.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great! And what time does the pool open?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt! ənd ˈwʌt ˈtaɪm dʌz ðə ˈpuːl ˈoʊpən?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: It opens at eight in the morning and closes at eight in the evening. It's on the rooftop.
dialogue.reading: ɪt ˈoʊpənz ət ˈeɪt ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ ənd ˈkloʊzɪz ət ˈeɪt ɪn ði ˈiːvnɪŋ. ɪts ɑːn ðə ˈruːftɑːp.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: A rooftop pool! And when does the spa open?
dialogue.reading: ə ˈruːftɑːp ˈpuːl! ənd ˈwɛn dʌz ðə ˈspɑː ˈoʊpən?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: The spa opens at ten, but it isn't free.
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈspɑː ˈoʊpənz ət ˈtɛn, bʌt ɪt ˈɪzənt ˈfriː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. Does the shuttle to the old city leave from here?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. dʌz ðə ˈʃʌtəl tə ði ˈoʊld ˈsɪti ˈliːv frəm ˈhɪr?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, it leaves every hour from the lobby. And it's free of charge, too.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ɪt ˈliːvz ˈɛvri ˈaʊər frəm ðə ˈlɑːbi. ənd ɪts ˈfriː əv ˈtʃɑːrdʒ, ˈtuː.
